# M1 combined-source play — three bounded evidence owners

All production code is frozen on the committed dispatch baseline recorded in TASKS. It combines original M1, A0, CORE, VISUAL, PRESENTATION/focus, RENDER and RECOVERY-FIX. Root has inspected each source and its attributed artifacts. These assignments close **combined-source gameplay evidence**, not independent review or M1 acceptance. Use three separate Sol 6.1 max T3 worktrees; only root dispatches. No source edits, children, peer polling, parent mutation, pushes, PRs or branch assembly.

Read AGENTS/STATUS, PLAN/CONTRACTS, the revised input, integration/fleet/delivery specifications, M1-PARALLEL and the Combined evidence checkpoints in `evidence/M1-COORDINATION-ASTRA.md`. Read relevant original CORE/RECOVERY/CARRIER/RENDER/RECOVERY-FIX reports plus root integration records. Prior runs are useful reproductions and component evidence, not a claim that the new assembled source has been played. Do not copy moving work or wait for other validators. Report a precise blocker, retain its save/inputs and continue unrelated cases; root assigns fixes.

## Shared method and proof

- Build the exact committed source; record JS/CSS hashes and actual browser resources. Root already runs the full combined test suite. Do not rerun all unchanged matrices or broad tests. Use targeted diagnostics only for a concrete uncertainty, and label them separately.
- Play through actual controls, UI actions and file-input imports. Read-only HUD/save observations and keyboard helpers are allowed. No state setters, teleports, injected inventory/damage or direct simulation calls as gameplay proof. Keep complete generated key edges and command/action counts, flushed to disk before **every navigation/reload**. Capture pre-refill reserves, before/after transaction saves and one retained final envelope. Selected short clips plus actual camera stills suffice; no continuous full-run video required.
- At command/reload boundaries verify full persisted state, with exact ordinary no-input tick deltas where necessary. Preserve source attribution of imported saves, session/creation metadata, item/container/vehicle IDs and public/maintenance provenance. Never count a seeded fixture as earned campaign progress.
- Inspect final cockpit/panes/optics, labels, UI focus/feedback, source/ecology relationships and hazard cues during the assigned actual route. Record concrete usability defects and what caused each retreat; agent familiarity cannot establish human learning/enjoyment or ten-hour duration.
- Each owner changes **only** its evidence file below. Use its own `/tmp` directory/archive with hashes, indexed original save copies, logs, media and clear exclusions. Return a clean evidence-only commit and close owned resources. Stop after the bounded result; completion wakes root. No independent acceptance claim.

## EXPEDITION — P0–P3 and return P5

Own `docs/build/evidence/M1-COMBINED-EXPEDITION.md`, `/tmp/siltwake-m1-combined-expedition/`, free port **5190**.

1. Fresh New Game through all opening actions into the pod, establish ordinary controls/bench/storage/ramp. In a separate new slot or retained branch check opening skip/replay/pause without duplicated rewards or drains. Start with a brief uninstrumented orientation using visible cues; record confusion before using prior route coordinates. This is an agent attempt, not a blind human test.
2. Complete a **fresh earned reef-first** C01–C04 route: material contexts and early evidence, repair/preparation, tools/suit/buoy/cells/Bobbin, workshop and Dart, useful upper-Canopy cargo, return/store/service and actual reload/Continue. Omit optional personal journal; do not import an older earned checkpoint for this main run. Record every collection/transfer/craft count and time/route segments. Show both suit and hull limits and launch north beyond the cradle before turning east/descending.
3. Confirm readable wildlife warning plus quiet/distraction/cover response, retreat, comfortable refuge, actionable ingredients/missing prerequisites and correct transfer focus/notices in this actual outing. Record conservative preparation/first-access air and power margins before replenishment (target at least25%). Do not hide a collision, loss, refill or rescue; retain exact checkpoint and consequence.
4. In a separate bounded new-game branch, island-first early C03→C02 order and hand food remain possible. Exercise paused command/immediate-save conservation for full inventory, missing prerequisite and blocked hull output where reachable. A separately labelled diagnostic may supplement an impractical case, not replace gameplay claims. Do not repeat the whole main route for this alternate.
5. Return/save/reload comparison includes pose/mode, findings/blueprints, source stock/reserves/facilities, all containers/items, Dart/charge/health. Keep operation-free main first-access reserves separate from failure branches. Check panel pause and bounded synthetic blur/focus remain paused without background drain; label synthetic focus. Prior deep lifecycle/lock matrices need not be repeated.

P4 is another owner's assignment. No carrier matrix, healthy battery exhaustion marathon or M2 expansion. Preserve a useful final earned save for later independent reviews.

## RECOVERY — P4 and recovery P5 on combined rendering

Own `docs/build/evidence/M1-COMBINED-RECOVERY.md`, `/tmp/siltwake-m1-combined-recovery/`, free port **5193**.

Use a byte-identical retained earned CORE `normal-return-saved.json` (source6b4f229, hash in RECOVERY report), imported through actual UI. This is earned-save replay on combined source, not fresh preparation. Prior RECOVERY/RECOVERY-FIX artifacts give ordinary routes and exact identities; reuse instructions without importing a pre-completed result as proof.

Cause gameplay disablement/incapacity in the implemented upper-Canopy area, retain the original hull/hold/modules/charge and fitted tools/knowledge, and demonstrate food from empty carried inventory at refuge. Reach the shallow staging point physically, deploy/attach Bobbin, complete the corrected full tow to `(51,-11,-54)`, read its notice/reopened guidance, apply a paid local patch, board the **rendered cockpit** and depart safely. Retain actual before/after/save cuts; no unchecked teleport or instant charge/repair.

Cause one further failed recovery/cache attempt and demonstrate continued recoverability with the same vessel and persistent caches; retrieve useful cargo, return/store/service and actual reload. Check ready/tow/completion phase saves and the main after-recovery state. One bounded replay of the unmodified old attached save can specifically confirm compatibility; no need to redo the full correction author diagnostic matrix. Genuine blocked route notice/panel retention can use its explicitly seeded existing-world obstruction case, kept separate from earned progress.

Ordinary battery depletion is desirable only if a natural near-empty earned case arises. Do not idle a healthy battery for hours. Keep ordinary exhaustion explicitly unverified if absent; previous labelled zero-power tests remain supplemental. Do not claim deep/all-fleet or designated mobile-refuge recovery; these remain M2.

## CARRIER — F0–F3 with final panes and orientation

Own `docs/build/evidence/M1-COMBINED-CARRIER.md`, `/tmp/siltwake-m1-combined-carrier/`, free port **5194**.

Use the supported **seeded carrier feasibility fixture**, separate from expedition storage. Run supported ordinary-control transitions on this combined source: F0 stop/station keeping/leave helm, bridge→actual passage→aft vestibule→helm, waterline and large-hull collision; F1 both compact dry berths, Dart launch while Spindle stays protected, blocked exit preserving identities/cargo/charge/damage, surface-only Spindle; F2 clear both slots through controls, return to supported dock, configure medium, approach/capture/launch actual medium craft with full transfer clearance; F3 prepared/lock actual save/reload, interruption/pause, obstruction after preparation, exactly-once detach and safe fallback on labelled carrier incapacity drill.

Inspect stored craft through final windows and corrected nonzero-heading hull/shell/berth alignment during these same transitions. Do not repeat the 72 aperture-ray/35 matrix/GLSL author diagnostics unchanged; this assignment establishes actual composed controls/render/save integration. Use prior CARRIER route/instructions and exact unmodified fixture saves for targeted transition cuts when useful, but identify imports and do not splice them into a falsely continuous route. Existing thin-throat rule tests remain separately attributed; use real available other-craft obstruction rather than inventing an unsupported geometry-placement control.

No campaign carrier acquisition, mobile-refuge registration or underway walking. Seeded pod fallback does not satisfy the later designated-mobile-refuge requirement. Prior correction command/schema source is unchanged by rendering; avoid broad unit-matrix reruns without a new failure.

## Browser isolation for every owner

Before opening/driving/launching a browser read `/work/repos/fleet/BROWSER_RULES.md` when available and `docs/BROWSER_RULES.md`. Verify factory-worker/isolated Linux owns the actual process; never automate the owner's Windows desktop. Prefer T3 preview_status then preview_open. Use one task-owned incognito context, isolated storage and the assigned **checked-free** port. Preserve historical tab14, user/shared/peer tabs, servers and all original evidence. No process-name kills. Keep input scripts and recordings bounded below tool timeouts; no abandoned timed-out controller. Close only task-owned tabs/server/recordings via normal lifecycle. Record renderer/hardware/quality/muted audio; SwiftShader proves no consumer-GPU performance and muted capture proves no audible mix.

After all three reports, root inspects/assembles evidence, freezes one candidate for the core/physical and presentation completion batches and dispatches fresh non-author Astra xhigh + Sol max reviewers. After that pair accepts, integrate into game/siltwake and run its separate integrated M1 gate. These validators are evidence authors, not the acceptance pair.
